items.title: 1.6 Periodic tarteeb aur electronic configuration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.6, printed pages 6-7, with Quick Check 1.2 as a self-check.

blocks.text: Periodic table mein elements ki tarteeb samajhne se un ki physical properties (jaise physical state aur atomic radius), un ki electronic structure aur chemical reactivity ke bare mein qeemti maloomat milti hai.

items: Period number principal quantum number (n) batata hai, yani nucleus ke gird kitne electron shells hain. Maslan 3rd period ke element X ke teen shells hain, aur us ke valence electrons 3rd shell mein hain. Valence electrons kis subshell mein hain, yeh element ke block (azimuthal quantum number) par depend karta hai. Agar 3rd period ka element X s-block mein hai to us ke valence electrons 3s subshell mein hain.

Group number valence electrons ki tadaad batata hai. Maslan 3rd period aur group 2 ke element X ke bahar wale shell mein do valence electrons hain. Yani 3rd period, group 2 (s-block) ke element ke do valence electrons 3s subshell mein hain, is liye X magnesium (Mg) hai.
Ek aur misal, jo period number aur group number ko electronic configuration aur table mein element ki jagah se jorti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ek jagah “the element Z” likhti hai, halan ke baat usi element X ki ho rahi hai (period 3, group 2, s-block), jo magnesium hai.
X group 13 aur period 3 mein hai.
Kyun ke X group 13 mein hai, is ke 3 valence electrons hain; aur kyun ke yeh period 3 mein hai, is ke nucleus ke gird teen shells hain.
Yani 3 valence electrons teesre (3rd) shell mein hain. Configuration yeh hogi:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Total electrons 2 + 8 + 3 = 13 hain, is liye atomic number 13 hai: yeh aluminium (Al) hai. Tareeqa yaad rakhein: period se shells ki tadaad, group se valence electrons, aur block se aakhri subshell.
Elements ki periodic tarteeb samajhne se kisi element ki electronic configuration samajh aati hai, aur configuration hi us ki chemical properties aur rawaiya (behaviour) samajhne ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.caption: Jagah se configuration parhna
rows: Shells ki tadaad (principal quantum number n)
Period 3: teen shells; valence electrons shell 3 mein

blocks.prompt: a) X group 14 aur period 2 mein hai. (i) X ki electronic configuration likhein. (ii) Is ka block batayein aur periodic table se element pehchanein.
blocks.explanation: Period 2 ka matlab do shells; group 14 ka matlab chaar valence electrons. Configuration: 1s² 2s² 2p². Aakhri electron p subshell mein hai, is liye p-block. Total 6 electrons, yani atomic number 6: carbon (C).

blocks.prompt: b) Period 4 aur group 17 ka element kaun sa hai?
blocks.explanation: Group 17 halogens ka group hai aur period 4 mein is ka element bromine (Br) hai; configuration [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s² 4p⁵.

items: Period number = shells ki tadaad (n); block = valence electrons ka subshell; group number = valence electrons ki tadaad.
Period 3, group 2 (s-block): 3s², magnesium. Period 3, group 13: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p¹, aluminium.
